title: Listing Review Requirements
content:
Use this guide when submitting a public app listing, upgrading a custom app to public, or updating an existing public app listing on the TikTok Shop App & Service Store. **Required** items apply to the scenarios specified in each row. **Recommended** items are optional improvements. Complete the fields and follow the current upload and input requirements shown in Partner Center. In this guide, **SEA** means Southeast Asia. **ISV Registration Country** identifies where your business is registered; **Target Sellers** identifies the seller groups you serve; and **Base Region** identifies those sellers’ origin regions, which may include multiple regions. For functional review requirements, see [App review requirements](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/app-review-requirements). | Rule ID | Category | Topic | Applies to | What to prepare or demonstrate | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | LR-ADM-001 | Eligibility and readiness | US market eligibility | Listings targeting the United States | **Required.** Your registration country and seller scope must match an eligible combination:
• **US registration, Local sellers only:** no Base Region restriction under this requirement.
• **US registration, Cross-border sellers only or both Local and Cross-border sellers:** Base Region must include CN.
• **CN or HK registration, Local sellers, Cross-border sellers, or both:** Base Region must include CN.
“Includes CN” allows additional regions. Both `CN` and `CN, KR`, for example, satisfy this condition. | | LR-ADM-002 | Eligibility and readiness | Mainland China registration and UK Local eligibility | Businesses registered in mainland China applying to serve UK Local sellers | **Required.** Businesses registered in mainland China are not currently eligible to list services for UK Local sellers. Before submitting, contact [Partner Center support](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/how-to-contact-support) or [partner.uk@tiktokshop.com](mailto:partner.uk@tiktokshop.com) to confirm and complete the applicable eligibility requirements. | | LR-ADM-003 | Eligibility and readiness | UK operating qualifications | Businesses applying to serve UK Local sellers, excluding businesses registered in mainland China | **Required.** Have the required UK operating qualifications and a local service and support team. A separate description of your office, address, or team is not required in the listing itself. If you cannot meet the UK Local requirements, you may consider serving UK Cross-border sellers, subject to the applicable requirements. | | LR-ADM-006 | Eligibility and readiness | Logistics and fulfillment services | Services involving production, warehousing, transport, delivery, or related software | **Recommended.** Explain what the service provides and who provides it. For management software, describe the work sellers can perform, such as receiving, inventory synchronization, or dispatch management. For physical fulfillment services, explain the responsibilities of your business and other providers. For example, a print-on-demand service can identify who handles customization, production, packaging, and shipping. | | LR-API-004 | Eligibility and readiness | App readiness | Public app listing submissions | **Required.** Submit an app that is ready for release. If your submission explicitly describes a test version that is still under development, complete development before applying.
For a first-time launch, the listing describes services that will become available after approval. Pre-launch statements on your website, FAQ, or privacy policy, such as ‘TikTok Shop is not yet supported’ or ‘Coming soon,’ are acceptable and do not by themselves mean that the app is unfinished. | | LR-TXT-001 | Basic information | Official app name | All listings | **Required.** Use an official product or brand name that identifies the service and matches what it provides. Do not use a name intended only for a test or development environment. Translated names and brand transliterations are acceptable when they identify the same service; language versions do not need identical wording. | | LR-OPT-008 | Basic information | Naming suggestions | All listings | **Recommended.** Choose a concise name that helps sellers recognize the brand and service. Examples include “{Company Name} Order Management” or “{Brand} ERP.” No fixed combination, word order, or naming template is required. | | LR-SEA-001 | Basic information | Service names in Southeast Asia | SEA listings | **Required.** Use a recognizable service name related to the actual service. Do not include “TikTok” or “TikTok Shop,” or use only a generic function such as “Order Management” or “Product Listing.” Examples such as “{Brand} ERP” and “{ISV Name} Content Management” are illustrative, not mandatory templates. You may use a longer name or less idiomatic wording as long as sellers can clearly understand the service name. | | LR-TXT-002 | Basic information | Service category | All listings | **Required.** Choose one available category that reasonably matches the service’s main purpose. Refer to the [App Category Selection Guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/hulvi36o). Multiple functions or overlap with neighboring categories are acceptable when the main purpose fits. The guide’s examples do not require your app to support every listed feature. For example, an ERP app may include print-on-demand order synchronization or inventory management. If no available category reasonably fits, contact support. Keep the description accurate rather than omitting real business activities to fit a category. | | LR-ADM-005 | Basic information | Service suitability for target sellers | UK Local and US Local listings | **Required.** The submitted content must help the selected sellers understand the service’s main functions and practical use. Update content that explicitly excludes the selected market or describes a service available only in an incompatible market. You do not need to repeat the market name in every field or write a separate local-market introduction. | | LR-MED-001 | Service details | Logo clarity and brand recognition | All listings | **Required.** Use a clear service logo that helps sellers recognize the service and its brand. Avoid blurred or low-quality logos that prevent recognition. | | LR-SEA-003 | Service details | Logo language and content | SEA listings | **Required.** Use your service’s own branding rather than TikTok or TikTok Shop official branding. Explanatory text in the logo must match the selected service language and listing text. Brand names, common technical terms, and URLs may retain their usual form. Avoid using screenshots or photographs as the service logo. | | LR-OPT-006 | Service details | Logo design | Listings with a service logo | **Recommended.** Use recognizable colors and shapes, keep the design simple, and focus on one or two elements. Square corners are recommended. | | LR-TXT-004 | Service details | Short and detailed descriptions | All listings | **Required.** The short description must summarize the service’s main purpose so sellers can quickly understand what it offers.
The detailed description must explain the app’s actual features and their uses or use cases, so sellers understand what the app does and how it can support their business. Add specific features or use cases if the description contains only slogans, generic benefits, or information that does not explain practical use.
You may reuse accurate, specific feature explanations from the key benefits or expand on how the service is used and what it offers. Images and other submitted content may provide supporting information.
For Local sellers, the submitted materials as a whole must explain what service is available to the selected market. Correct statements that exclude that market or materially conflict with the application.
Functional descriptions, use cases, or practical explanations are acceptable. No fixed sentence structure, quantified benefit, or separate TikTok Shop integration paragraph is required. Concise wording is sufficient when the features and uses are clear. | | LR-OPT-007 | Service details | Description and key-benefit writing | Listings containing descriptions or key benefits | **Recommended.** Use the short description to highlight the service’s purpose and main seller benefits. Explain key benefits in short, connected text, and avoid keyword-heavy or disjointed wording. In the detailed description, focus on actual features and what makes the service useful or distinctive, with enough information and less excessive marketing language. Avoid repeatedly naming the platform when that space could explain the service.
No fixed sentence structure, example feature or performance level, quantified benefit, or proof of competitive advantage is required.
Example short description: ‘Help sellers sync products to their TikTok seller store or mobile app.’
Example key-benefit title: ‘One-click product sync.’
Example key-benefit description: ‘Create product listings and automatically sync product details, prices, and inventory from your connected stores to your TikTok seller store.’
Use examples only when they accurately describe your service. | | LR-MED-002 | Service details | Static main and additional images | Listings with a static main image or additional listing images, in all markets | **Required.** Static main images and additional listing images must explain the service’s actual functions, purpose, use cases, or value to sellers. You may show feature introductions, service workflows, or relevant teams, facilities, and business activities.
Images, descriptions, and key benefits must be consistent when describing the same feature, service scope, or important commitment. Different parts may emphasize different aspects or provide complementary information.
Do not use raw system screenshots as static main images or additional listing images. Combine product interfaces with explanations of the corresponding functions or uses to create promotional images.
Choose a static main image or a main video to suit your service. A video cover serves as the preview image for the main video. | | LR-MED-003 | Service details | Different logo and static main image | Listings containing both a service logo and a static main image | **Required.** Use different images for the service logo and static main image. The logo identifies the service’s brand; the static main image gives further information about its value and user experience.
A video cover may use the same image as the service logo. | | LR-MED-006 | Service details | Main video content | Listings containing a main video | **Required.** The main video must explain this app’s actual functions, purpose, or use by TikTok sellers. It must be consistent with the descriptions and key benefits when explaining the same feature, service scope, or important commitment.
Acceptable formats include introduction videos, feature-explanation slides, a presenter explaining the service, relevant business activities, or product recordings with narration, subtitles, or feature labels. You may focus on one or several actual features, purposes, or use cases.
Do not submit a video that only cycles through raw system screenshots or shows a system recording without explanations of the relevant functions or uses. Product interfaces must be presented together with explanations.
Replace a video mainly about another app, or mainly about another platform without explaining its relationship to this service and its use for TikTok sellers.
Example: a video explaining how the app connects Amazon and TikTok seller stores, synchronizes inventory, and helps sellers manage their business is acceptable. | | LR-REG-002 | Service details | Main media value in Brazil and Mexico | Listings whose Target Market includes BR or MX and that contain a static main image or main video | **Required.** The static main image or main video itself must highlight the service’s benefits and value to sellers. | | LR-SEA-002 | Service details | Key benefits | SEA listings | **Required.** Titles must communicate an actual function, service purpose, or seller benefit. Descriptions must help sellers understand that function or purpose and remain relevant to the service. Clear functional phrases such as “Inventory sync” are acceptable. Complete sentences, quantified benefits, and proof of competitive advantage are not required. | | LR-MED-004 | Service details | Different static main and additional images | Listings containing both a static main image and additional listing images | **Required.** Do not use the same image as both the static main image and an additional listing image. Resizing or compressing the same image does not make it different.
The same image may be used as a video cover and an additional listing image.
Shared branding, colors, or templates are acceptable when the images show different feature screens or substantially different content. | | LR-OPT-001 | Service details | Additional images | All listings | **Required.** Provide at least three additional listing images for each submitted language version to introduce the service, for example through featured functions or success stories.
Only images submitted in the additional listing images field count toward this minimum. The service logo, static main image, video cover, and images embedded in the detailed description do not count. | | LR-OPT-005 | Service details | Detailed description length | SEA listing versions with more than 2,000 visible characters in the detailed description | **Recommended.** Aim for no more than 2,000 visible characters for readability. Count only the text sellers can see, excluding formatting tags. You may exceed this recommendation; follow any character limit enforced by the submission form. | | LR-REG-004 | Service details | Shoppable Content scope | Businesses registered in mainland China submitting Shoppable Content listings for US Cross-border sellers or ACCU sellers (American companies with a Chinese ultimate beneficial owner) | **Required.** Focus the main description on content-publishing capabilities. Related content creation, publishing management, and analytics may be included. Supporting features are acceptable when they do not change the main service being offered. | | LR-CON-002 | Contact and support | Support email | SEA listings | **Required.** The email address provided must be a contact channel for the service’s support team. | | LR-CON-001 | Contact and support | Phone number | Listings with a phone number | **Required if provided.** The phone number is optional. If entered, it must be a valid service contact and a local number for the listing’s target market. This applies to Local sellers, Cross-border sellers, and listings serving both. An international country code or a valid local number format may be used. Selecting a country code without entering a number counts as leaving the optional number blank. | | LR-CON-003 | Contact and support | Official website and help resources | All listings | **Required.** Provide an official website (Partner official website) for each submitted language version. A user guide or FAQ (Service FAQ) is optional.
The website may be your company’s or service provider’s general website, a relevant business portal, or a service landing page. It must open correctly and provide basic information about the company, business, or service.
If you provide a user guide or FAQ, you may link to online instructions, FAQs, a help center, or a support-ticket page. Any one of these formats is sufficient. The content or support channel must relate to the service or its provider; a ticket page that lets sellers ask questions or contact support is acceptable.
Simple websites and help resources are acceptable and may be expanded over time. You may use the same URL in both fields if the page provides both company or service information and help or support. | | LR-API-001 | Integration settings | API access and production URLs | All ISV app Listing Review submissions | **Required.** Enable API access and configure a Callback URL to receive the seller’s authorization code for this app. Use the Callback URL for the app’s production authorization flow. A Webhook URL is optional; if provided, it must be the app’s production endpoint for receiving event notifications.
Replace Callback or Webhook URLs used only for testing, debugging, or example demonstrations with the production endpoint for the corresponding purpose.
If the app was created without Enable API and has no linked App key, create a new app with Enable API turned on, configure its Callback URL, and submit the new app for Listing Review.
If API access is already enabled but the Callback URL is missing, or an existing URL needs replacement, update the original app through the options available for its current review status. | | LR-IP-001 | General content requirements | TikTok names and official branding | Listings using TikTok or TikTok Shop names or branding | **Required.** Use your own service brand in the app name and your own identity for the service logo. The service logo must not contain TikTok or TikTok Shop official names, official graphic marks, or imitation elements.
If Target Market does not include US, descriptions, static main images, additional listing images, embedded images, and video covers may use TikTok or TikTok Shop names and marks to accurately explain supported platforms or integrations. Clearly distinguish your service from an official product.
If Target Market includes US, do not use ‘TikTok Shop’ or ‘TikTok official’ in short descriptions, key benefits, detailed descriptions, or text in listing images. You may use wording such as ‘TikTok sellers’ or ‘TikTok buyers’ to identify the users you serve. Listing images must not contain TikTok or TikTok Shop official logos, including in connector diagrams.
Platform names and marks in videos must accurately identify an integration or the source of the footage; platform source marks may remain.
All listings must clearly distinguish the service from an official product. Do not claim official status or make unsupported partnership, certification, or endorsement claims. | | LR-IP-002 | General content requirements | Third-party brands and relationships | Listings claiming a third-party partnership, certification, or endorsement, or using another brand as the app’s own identity | **Required.** Have a valid basis covering the claimed relationship and intended use. Correct unsupported claims, misleading brand use, or use known to lack the necessary permission. Accurately identifying supported platforms, APIs, or connection capabilities—including in connector diagrams and demonstrations—does not require a separate authorization letter for every platform mentioned. | | LR-IP-003 | General content requirements | People in promotional content | Content using an identifiable person’s name, image, or video as an endorsement or commercial promotional subject | **Recommended.** Confirm permission covering the intended use and prefer your own or appropriately licensed material. Listing Review does not require an authorization letter for every person shown. Illustrative avatars, example people, and ordinary interface content do not require additional individual authorization documents. Sensitive-information requirements still apply. | | LR-SEA-005 | General content requirements | Accurate promotional claims | SEA short descriptions, key-benefit titles, and detailed descriptions | **Required.** Accurately reflect the service’s actual functions, uses, and applicable conditions. Make the scope of numerical results, guarantees, rankings, and certifications clear. Different sections may emphasize different features without being inconsistent. Routine submission of performance, architecture, or load-testing reports is not required for every claim. If clarification is requested about a specific claim, provide relevant information. | | LR-MED-007 | General content requirements | Personal information and business data | Images or videos containing interfaces, accounts, orders, or other business data | **Required.** When images or videos show personal contact information, complete delivery or logistics details, or records linking a person, shop, or creator to orders, transaction amounts, sales, or commissions, use test or fictional data or hide the fields and associations that could identify or contact someone or reveal a transaction.
You may show people who are relevant to your service or team, and public shop or creator names and avatars when introducing those parties. Redact associated non-public transaction, financial, and personal information.
Clearly identified test or fictional data, masked passwords, and anonymized aggregate data that cannot be linked to a specific person or seller may be shown. Do not expose credentials that provide access to real accounts, systems, or data.
Examples: a sales chart clearly labeled as belonging to a fictional shop is acceptable. Mask a team member’s real email address. For records linking a name to an order number, date, amount, and fulfillment status, use sample records or hide identifying fields and associations. | | LR-MED-008 | General content requirements | Contact details in images | Listings containing a service logo, static main image, additional listing image, embedded image, or video cover | **Required.** Listing images must not contain telephone numbers, email addresses, WeChat IDs, WeChat QR codes, or other contact QR codes used to contact a person or business.
Fully mask such contact details when they appear in screenshots or other interface images. Remove contact QR codes or make them unscannable.
Provide service support contact details through the listing’s phone-number and support-email fields. | | LR-TXT-006 | General content requirements | Language and understandable content | All listing language versions provided in Partner Center | **Required.** For non-EU markets, the short description, detailed description, key benefits, static main image, additional listing images, and main video in each language version must use that version’s language. For example, an English listing uses English, a Chinese listing uses Chinese, and a German listing uses German.
For EU markets, these materials may use either English or the language of that version.
Brand names, common technical terms, URLs, and small amounts of interface text that do not affect understanding may retain their usual form. | | LR-REG-003 | General content requirements | Readable layout | BR and MX listings | **Required.** Keep text readable and associated with the correct fields. Correct misplaced, obscured, corrupted, or disorganized content that makes the main service information difficult to understand. Color, font, decorative choices, and stylistic consistency are otherwise recommendations. | | LR-SEA-006 | General content requirements | Punctuation and symbols | SEA short descriptions, key-benefit titles, and detailed descriptions | **Recommended.** Use clear text, ordinary punctuation, and an appropriate amount of symbols. Emojis, check marks, and decorative symbols are acceptable when they do not obscure information or interfere with readability. | | LR-OPT-004 | General content requirements | Consistent presentation | All listings | **Recommended.** Coordinate fonts, font-size hierarchy, text colors, backgrounds, and paragraph spacing so headings, body text, and feature explanations are easy to recognize. Use consistent formatting for content at the same level, and check for unexpected size, color, or background changes introduced by copying and pasting.
For example, keep the font size and background consistent within a paragraph; different sections may use a clear heading hierarchy and color scheme. | | LR-MED-005 | General content requirements | Media readability | Listings containing images or videos | **Required.** Submitted files must open correctly, with important visuals, text, and feature information clear enough to understand. Avoid blurred or low-quality media that prevents understanding. | | LR-OPT-003 | General content requirements | Effective promotional media | Listings containing a static main image, additional listing images, or a main video | **Recommended.** Prominently explain the service’s value to sellers or how sellers use and experience it. Highlight important interface features with close-ups, clear headings, or feature labels, and reduce tiny or hard-to-read interface elements and text. Choose the business value, user experience, features, or workflow most useful for explaining your service. | | LR-LANG-001 | General content requirements | English presentation for US Local sellers | US Local listings with an English version available in Partner Center | **Recommended.** Explain the service clearly in English. Where useful, provide English explanations on linked websites. US-registered Affiliate (Creator collaboration) services may also provide English explanations in images and linked content. Brand names, common terms, URLs, and minor amounts of other-language text may retain their usual form. | | LR-LANG-002 | General content requirements | Portuguese presentation | Brazil Local listings with a Portuguese version available in Partner Center | **Recommended.** Explain the main service information clearly in Portuguese, including relevant image content. Brand names, common terms, URLs, and minor amounts of other-language text may retain their usual form. | | LR-LANG-003 | General content requirements | Spanish presentation | Mexico Local listings with a Spanish version available in Partner Center | **Recommended.** Explain the main service information clearly in Spanish, including relevant image content. Brand names, common terms, URLs, and minor amounts of other-language text may retain their usual form. | | LR-LANG-005 | General content requirements | Chinese listings for Brazil and Mexico | BR or MX listings with a Chinese version available in Partner Center | **Recommended.** Provide Chinese explanations of service information in the listing, images, and linked websites. Brand names, common terms, URLs, and minor amounts of other-language text may retain their usual form. | | LR-LANG-006 | General content requirements | English presentation for UK listings | UK listings with an English version available in Partner Center | **Recommended.** Provide clear English explanations of the main service information in text, images, and videos. Brand names, common terms, URLs, and minor amounts of other-language text may retain their usual form. | | LR-LANG-008 | General content requirements | Language presentation for other Local markets | Local listings outside the US, BR, MX, and UK, with an English or local-language version available in Partner Center | **Recommended.** Use understandable English or the target market’s local language. Both are not required. Brand names, common terms, URLs, and minor amounts of other-language text may retain their usual form. These recommendations do not require additional language versions. |
